column1: # Every test class that boots its own Postgres (nexus-0ty8z, step 1).
# A class is a caller of PgContainerHelper.startEmptyDatabase / startDedicated / newContainer, or a
# class that was moved onto a template clone and must stay there (call=clone).
# Columns: class <TAB> call <TAB> kind <TAB> reason.  DbStartClassificationGateTest enforces the table
# both ways: an unlisted caller fails, a stale row fails. A class whose subject is NOT the walk or a
# cluster-level fact has no kind here; it takes a clone (PgContainerHelper.start() or startMigratedByOwner()).
